sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of a 1974 federal statute. The law addresses unclaimed financial instruments. States disagree on which instruments the law covers. The dispute centers on statutory interpretation. The Court must define the term used in the statute. This definition determines which state receives the funds.
